name: Polynomial Congruence Obfuscation
description: Replaces the easily recognizable "product is a perfect square" rule with a mathematically equivalent modular arithmetic condition: $(p^2+q^2) \equiv 2pq \pmod 3$. This evaluates to $p=q$ for $p,q \in \{1,2,3\}$, but obscures the 3-coloring reduction by requiring algebraic simplification or truth-table generation, breaking the surface-level pattern match.
